label: groupgreedy_genre15
generous_assumption: The favourite-genre answer is treated as FREE SIDE INFORMATION: it costs NO turn and is NOT folded into the recommender, so the comparison is 15 ITEMS vs 15 ITEMS. A deployed system would have to ask for it and would pay a turn. This is GENEROUS TO THE CONDITIONED ARM by construction -- every gain here is an UPPER BOUND.
sanity_meaning: `sanity_pass` is a HARNESS check, NOT evidence. On the SELECTION cohort the group's own 15-item order is GUARANTEED to be >= the global order's first 15 items, because the global order lies inside every group's search space. A pass means the search, the cohort masking and the memo are correct and NOTHING ELSE. What carries information: the MAGNITUDE of the gain, the gain-vs-group-size relation (overfitting), and the order overlap with the global order.
branch_question: OPEN: what is your favourite genre? (FREE -- no turn charged)
branch_rule: most frequent MovieLens genre over the user's LIKED FOLD-IN items (lvl_lookup level >= 7 == >= 4.0 stars); ties broken ALPHABETICALLY; no liked/genred fold-in item -> group 'none'. Held-out targets are excluded by construction and asserted at runtime.
comparison: ITEM-FOR-ITEM: the group's first K items vs the global order's first K items, K in [1, 2, 4, 8, 15]. There is no total-budget curve: the genre answer is free.
